session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, EOD Trading Range'. Bull trap at the open (follow-through bear entry bar disappointing so bulls exited around breakeven), a small pullback bear trend with body gaps and many weak sell signal bars (sell on a stop below any bar closing near its low), the midday minor reversal rally to the EMA off the 4015 low (99.9% chance of rally to EMA), the bear breakdown off the 4022 double top into the 4003 low, and the blue dotted converging EOD trading range into the close.
